interface.signature: def omit_hashtag(message: str, hashtag: str) -> str:

preconditions.expression: all(c.isalnum() or c == '#' for c in hashtag)
preconditions.description: The hashtag consists only of alphanumeric characters and exactly one leading '#'.
Both message and hashtag are strings.

postconditions.expression: return_value == message.replace(hashtag, '', 1) if hashtag in message else message
postconditions.description: The returned string is the original message with the first occurrence of the hashtag removed (including the '#'). If the hashtag is not found, the message remains unchanged.
